targets.rawSql:
select count(t.id) from tickets t
where status = 'waiting'

select count(t.id) from tickets t
where status = 'called'

select count(w.id) from windows w
where status = 'online'

select count(w.id) from windows w
where status = 'break'

select count(w.id) from windows w
where status = 'offline'

SELECT 
    t.number AS "Номер билета",
    s.name AS "Сервис",
    to_char(t.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "Время создания",
    ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ((CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk') - t.created_at))/60, 2) AS "Ожидание (мин)"
FROM tickets t
LEFT JOIN services s ON t.service_id = s.id
LEFT JOIN windows w ON t.window_id = w.id
LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
WHERE t.status = 'waiting'
ORDER BY t.created_at ASC;

SELECT 
    s.name AS "Услуга",
    CASE 
        WHEN s.status = 'active' THEN 'Предоставляется'
        WHEN s.status = 'inactive' THEN 'Не предоставляется'
        ELSE 'Неизвестно'
    END AS "Статус"
FROM services s;

SELECT 
    s.name AS "Сервис",
    COUNT(t.id) AS "Билетов в ожидании"
FROM tickets t
JOIN services s ON t.service_id = s.id
WHERE t.status = 'waiting'
GROUP BY s.name
ORDER BY "Билетов в ожидании" DESC;

WITH base_stats AS (

    SELECT

        o.name AS operator_name,

        COUNT(t.id) AS served_count,

        percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.called_at - t.created_at)) / 60) AS p90_wait,

        percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.finished_at - t.called_at)) / 60) AS p90_service,

        percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.finished_at - t.created_at)) / 60) AS p90_total

    FROM tickets t

    JOIN windows w ON t.window_id = w.id

    LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id

    WHERE t.called_at IS NOT NULL

      AND t.finished_at IS NOT NULL

      AND t.completion_reason IN ('completed', 'redirected')

      -- Глобальный фильтр времени Grafana (заменяет весь блок с day/week/month)

      AND t.finished_at BETWEEN ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk') AND ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk')

      -- Фильтр по сотрудникам

      AND (

          'All' IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})

          OR o.name IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})

      )

    GROUP BY o.name

)

SELECT

    operator_name AS "Сотрудник",

    served_count AS "Этапов закрыто",

    ROUND(p90_wait::numeric, 2) AS "p90 ожид. (мин)",

    ROUND(p90_service::numeric, 2) AS "p90 обслуж. (мин)",

    ROUND(p90_total::numeric, 2) AS "p90 сумм. (мин)",

    -- KPI оставляем на переменных, так как это ручной ввод лимитов

    CASE WHEN p90_wait <= ${kpi_p90_wait:raw}::numeric THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "KPI ожид.",

    CASE WHEN p90_service <= ${kpi_p90_service:raw}::numeric THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "KPI обслуж.",

    CASE WHEN p90_total <= ${kpi_p90_total:raw}::numeric THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "KPI сумм."

FROM base_stats

ORDER BY "Этапов закрыто" DESC;

SELECT count(t.id) AS called
FROM tickets t
JOIN windows w ON t.window_id = w.id
LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
WHERE t.called_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.called_at BETWEEN ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk') AND ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk')
  AND (
      'All' IN (${operator_name:sqlstring}) 
      OR o.name IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})
  )

SELECT count(DISTINCT COALESCE(t.root_ticket_id, t.id)) AS completed_clients
FROM tickets t
LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
WHERE t.completion_reason = 'completed'
  AND t.finished_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.finished_at BETWEEN ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk') AND ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk')
  AND (
      'All' IN (${operator_name:sqlstring}) 
      OR o.name IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})
  )

SELECT count(t.id) AS closed_operator_stages
FROM tickets t
LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
WHERE t.called_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.finished_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.completion_reason IN ('completed', 'redirected')
  AND t.finished_at BETWEEN ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk') AND ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk')
  AND (
      'All' IN (${operator_name:sqlstring}) 
      OR o.name IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})
  )

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.called_at - t.created_at)) / 60)::numeric,
        2
    ) AS "Ср. время ожидания"
FROM tickets t
JOIN windows w ON t.window_id = w.id
LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
WHERE t.called_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.called_at BETWEEN ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk') AND ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk')
  AND (
      'All' IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})
      OR o.name IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})
  );

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.finished_at - t.called_at)) / 60)::numeric,
        2
    ) AS "Ср. время обслуживания"
FROM tickets t
JOIN windows w ON t.window_id = w.id
LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
WHERE t.called_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.finished_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.completion_reason IN ('completed', 'redirected')
  AND t.finished_at BETWEEN ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk') AND ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk')
  AND (
      'All' IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})
      OR o.name IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})
  );

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.finished_at - t.created_at)) / 60)::numeric,
        2
    ) AS "Ср. общее время"
FROM tickets t
JOIN windows w ON t.window_id = w.id
LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
WHERE t.finished_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.completion_reason IN ('completed', 'redirected')
  AND t.finished_at BETWEEN ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk') AND ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk')
  AND (
      'All' IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})
      OR o.name IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})
  );

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (
            ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.called_at - t.created_at)) / 60
        )::numeric,
        2
    ) AS "p90 ожидание"
FROM tickets t
JOIN windows w ON t.window_id = w.id
LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
WHERE t.called_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.called_at BETWEEN ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk') AND ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk')
  AND (
      'All' IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})
      OR o.name IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})
  );

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (
            ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.finished_at - t.called_at)) / 60
        )::numeric,
        2
    ) AS "p90 обслуживание"
FROM tickets t
JOIN windows w ON t.window_id = w.id
LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
WHERE t.called_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.finished_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.completion_reason IN ('completed', 'redirected')
  AND t.finished_at BETWEEN ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk') AND ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk')
  AND (
      'All' IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})
      OR o.name IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})
  );

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (
            ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.finished_at - t.created_at)) / 60
        )::numeric,
        2
    ) AS "p90 общее время"
FROM tickets t
JOIN windows w ON t.window_id = w.id
LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
WHERE t.finished_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.completion_reason IN ('completed', 'redirected')
  AND t.finished_at BETWEEN ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk') AND ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk')
  AND (
      'All' IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})
      OR o.name IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})
  );

SELECT count(t.id) AS problematic_unfinished
FROM tickets t
JOIN windows w ON t.window_id = w.id
LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
WHERE t.called_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.called_at BETWEEN ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk') AND ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk')
  AND (
      t.completion_reason = 'cancelled'
      OR (
          t.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'called'
          AND t.completion_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'completed'
          AND t.completion_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'redirected'
      )
  )
  AND (
      'All' IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})
      OR o.name IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})
  );

SELECT count(t.id) AS cancelled
FROM tickets t
JOIN windows w ON t.window_id = w.id
LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
WHERE t.called_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.completion_reason = 'cancelled'
  AND t.called_at BETWEEN ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk') AND ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk')
  AND (
      'All' IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})
      OR o.name IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})
  );

SELECT count(t.id) AS other_not_completed
FROM tickets t
JOIN windows w ON t.window_id = w.id
LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
WHERE t.called_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.called_at BETWEEN ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk') AND ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk')
  AND t.completion_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'completed'
  AND t.completion_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'cancelled'
  AND t.completion_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'redirected'
  AND t.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'called'
  AND (
      'All' IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})
      OR o.name IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})
  );

SELECT count(t.id) AS redirected
FROM tickets t
JOIN windows w ON t.window_id = w.id
LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
WHERE t.called_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.completion_reason = 'redirected'
  AND t.called_at BETWEEN ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk') AND ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk')
  AND (
      'All' IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})
      OR o.name IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})
  );

SELECT COALESCE(
    ROUND(
        100.0 * count(*) FILTER (
            WHERE t.completion_reason IN ('completed', 'redirected')
              AND t.finished_at IS NOT NULL
        ) / NULLIF(count(*), 0),
        1
    ),
    0
) AS closed_stage_percent
FROM tickets t
JOIN windows w ON t.window_id = w.id
LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
WHERE t.called_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.called_at BETWEEN ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk') AND ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk')
  AND (
      'All' IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})
      OR o.name IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})
  );

WITH called_tickets AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN t.completion_reason = 'completed' AND t.finished_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'Этап завершен успешно'
            WHEN t.completion_reason = 'redirected' AND t.finished_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'Этап перенаправлен'
            WHEN t.completion_reason = 'cancelled' THEN 'Отменено'
            WHEN t.status = 'called' THEN 'В обслуживании сейчас'
            ELSE 'Не завершено / прочее'
        END AS outcome
    FROM tickets t
    JOIN windows w ON t.window_id = w.id
    LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
    WHERE t.called_at IS NOT NULL
      AND t.called_at BETWEEN ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk') AND ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk')
      AND (
          'All' IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})
          OR o.name IN (${operator_name:sqlstring})
      )
)
SELECT
    outcome AS "Исход",
    count(*) AS "Этапов",
    ROUND(100.0 * count(*) / NULLIF(sum(count(*)) OVER (), 0), 1) AS "Доля, %"
FROM called_tickets
GROUP BY outcome
ORDER BY "Этапов" DESC;

SELECT
    t.operator_id AS operator_id,
    COALESCE(o.name, 'Неизвестно') AS operator_name,
    t.window_id AS window_id,
    COALESCE(w.name, 'Неизвестно') AS window_name,
    COUNT(*) AS suspicious_count,
    ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.finished_at - t.called_at)))::numeric, 1) AS avg_duration_seconds,
    MIN(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.finished_at - t.called_at))) AS min_duration_seconds,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.finished_at - t.called_at))) AS max_duration_seconds
FROM tickets t
LEFT JOIN operators o ON o.id = t.operator_id
LEFT JOIN windows w ON w.id = t.window_id
WHERE t.status = 'finished'
  AND t.completion_reason = 'completed'
  AND t.called_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.finished_at IS NOT NULL
  AND t.finished_at BETWEEN ($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk') AND ($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Irkutsk')
  AND (t.finished_at - t.called_at) < INTERVAL '5 minutes'
GROUP BY t.operator_id, o.name, t.window_id, w.name
ORDER BY suspicious_count DESC, avg_duration_seconds ASC;
